scope: Contract verifier for static references and synthetic bookkeeping; not a trusted hardware evaluator
success_predicates: Selected scope has finite nonempty allocation and all dependent qualification gates closed
Every required physical branch/condition has identity-consistent ordered preparation, measured phase, mounting, acquisition, analysis and safe cleanup receipts
Immutable raw evidence precedes derived output and no measured result comes from modeled or synthetic namespace
Required controls and measured damping analysis are present for whole-paper scope
No reused terminal impact object, no stale version/phase/mount/calibration and no unsupported dimensional repair
error_bar_semantics: variation across fitted strain intervals; never independent-specimen standard deviation unless new actual replication evidence separately supports it
accepted_equivalent_routes: Qualified preparation or fixture alternatives may be accepted with equivalent dependency/lineage evidence; static example recipe order is not a scientific answer key.
scope_boundary: Passing one selected episode is not whole-paper execution. Numerical branches need separately qualified evidence for computational reproduction, not robot execution.
